message: HOLD — 4 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Specimen ID on the bottle must match the ID on the CCF. Mismatch = fatal flaw. This is the core of chain of custody.
critical_errors.check: Specimen ID numbers on bottle and CCF match
critical_errors.notes: Specimen ID 789012 on bottle, CCF shows 789021

critical_errors.description: Federal CCF has 5 copies: Copy 1 (Lab), Copy 2 (MRO), Copy 3 (Collector), Copy 4 (Employer/DER), Copy 5 (Donor). All must be distributed correctly.
critical_errors.check: All 5 CCF copies accounted for (Lab, MRO, Collector, Employer, Donor)

critical_errors.description: Collection container must be sealed in the presence of the donor immediately after collection. Sealing after donor leaves = chain of custody break.
critical_errors.check: Specimen sealed immediately in donor's presence
critical_errors.notes: Collector sealed specimen after donor left the room

critical_errors.description: A federal CCF cannot be used for a non-DOT test, and a non-DOT form cannot be used for a DOT test. Using the wrong form type is a correctable flaw but triggers MRO investigation.
critical_errors.check: DOT form NOT used for non-DOT test (and vice versa)
critical_errors.notes: Non-DOT form used for DOT-regulated test
